source: reproductions of bugs surfaced by Reg's live Cowork run

bug_empty_patch_default_budget.repro: store = 9 relevant longish facts + 8 stale (mark_stale'd) facts; query 'describe the schema tables design'; budget=700 (default)
bug_empty_patch_default_budget.result: patch returned EMPTY ('No selected context fits the configured budget'), 0 selected, 20 tokens, despite 9 in-budget relevant facts
bug_empty_patch_default_budget.root_cause: compiler.compile_context final-render path: after greedy selection (which stays under budget), it re-renders with the FULL excluded list; stale items ranked below the greedy cutoff inflate the 'Avoid Stale/Superseded' block that the greedy trials never counted; if that final patch exceeds budget it sets selected=[] and returns force_tiny placeholder -- all-or-nothing, no graceful degradation. Worsens as a store accumulates stale facts.

bug_one_sided_savings_metric.repro: tiny store (2 short facts, full_history=8 tok); 10 prepare calls with unrelated queries
bug_one_sided_savings_metric.result: each call patch=201 tok vs full_history=8 tok (25x MORE); reported savings_pct=0.0, saved_tokens_total=0; TRUE net = -1930 tokens (spent far more than sending full history)
bug_one_sided_savings_metric.root_cause: saved_tokens = max(0, full_history - patch) per call, so a call that costs MORE than full history is recorded as 0 saved, never negative. Headline savings_pct = sum(saved)/sum(full) counts only wins; the meter cannot report a net loss. On small stores or empty-patch calls every call is a loss the meter hides.
